text: (Rocket Remnants) a Patchwork Pokémon carries one gadget, chosen at random from three when it enters and shown to the player: a net (the target's Speed −2 for 2 turns), a smoke ball (both sides' accuracy −1 for 2 turns), or a spring (it is launched back to its Ball and the next Pokémon comes in). The gadget goes off once, on the turn the Pokémon would first be hit (announced: "Something goes sproing.").

(Team Snag'em) a Snagged Pokémon was taken from its trainer and remembers. At the end of each turn there is a chance it refuses its snagger and skips its next turn: 20% on the first turn, +10% each turn after (announced: "It is looking for someone who isn't here."). Returned to its real trainer, it loses the rule.

a Black-Label Pokémon cannot be forced to switch out, and the first hit it takes in each battle does 20% less damage (announced: "The tag holds it in place."). Knock Off, Thief or winning the battle removes the tag; a caught or freed Black-Label Pokémon loses the rule and keeps its signature trait.

a Dark Ball Pokémon enters every battle with +1 Attack and +1 Special Attack, and loses 1/16 of its HP at the end of each turn (announced: "The Ball burns."). The rule ends when its trainer is beaten. A Dark Ball Pokémon taken into custody cracks its Ball and keeps only its signature trait.
(Team Aqua) in rain, a Tidebound Pokémon enters with +1 Speed and its Water moves cannot miss; in harsh sun it has neither (announced: "The tide is with it." / "The tide is out.").
(Team Magma) in harsh sun, a Cinderborn Pokémon enters with +1 Defense and its Fire and Ground moves cannot miss; in rain it has neither (announced: "The ground is warm." / "The ground is cold.").

a Spiritless Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by the foe, cannot be raised by anyone, and it cannot flinch, be taunted or be infatuated (announced: "It feels nothing about that."). The rule is removed by purifying it like a Tier 1 Shadow, or by returning Mesprit to Lake Verity, which restores every Spiritless Pokémon in the region at once.

an Overclocked Pokémon's first move each time it enters has +1 priority. At the end of its third consecutive turn on the field it overheats: −1 to every stat until it switches out (announced: "The machine has asked too much.").

a Couture Pokémon carries a second held item, its accessory, shown to the player at the start of battle. Knock Off, Thief and similar moves remove the accessory first (announced: "Its accessory is knocked askew."). A Couture Pokémon that is caught or freed keeps the accessory as an ordinary item.

(Team Skull) when a Tagged-Up Pokémon enters it sprays a tag on the field. Until it faints, the first time each foe switches in it loses 1/16 HP and is "called out" (its name appears in the tag; purely for show, and the Grunts love it).

(Aether Foundation) a Preserved Pokémon has been kept cold. It enters with −1 Speed, cannot be given a status condition, and takes 25% less damage from the first hit after it enters (announced: "It was kept very carefully.").
(Macro Cosmos) once per battle an Overcharged Pokémon may Dynamax for one turn with no Power Spot. On the turn after, it cannot act (announced: "It is paying for that.").

(Team Yell) a Loud Pokémon's sound-based moves have +20% power, and it gains +1 Speed each time a Yell Grunt in the stands cheers (once per turn, if any are watching). If the player holds Marnie's League Card, every Loud Pokémon loses its first turn to embarrassment (announced: "It has remembered who it is cheering for.").

once per battle a Tuned Pokémon may Terastallize into its squad's type for 2 turns without a charged Tera Orb. When it ends, the Pokémon stalls: −1 Speed for the rest of the battle (announced: "It's borrowed. It has to give it back.").
